data.name: Conduit
data.subtitle: Native client for Open WebUI & Ollama
data.localizedDescription: Conduit is a native, open-source iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Ollama and Hermes. Chat with your own self-hosted local models or API-backed ones with a polished SwiftUI interface — conversations stay in sync, code blocks render properly, and your data never touches a third-party server.
data.versionDescription:
Conduit 4.1.9 | conduit

## What's Changed
* Make the test suite faster and leaner by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/774
* On-device web search, model logos, and chat polish for Direct models by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/775
* Fix iOS attachment panel height feedback loop by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/783
* feat(chat): native image viewer with gallery paging by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/792
* Fix sign-in, Direct, Hermes and chat bugs found in an iOS UI test pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/790
* Fix notes, channels, workspace and settings bugs found in an iOS UI test pass by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/791
* Forget Direct and Hermes connections on sign-out; keep channel threads live by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/793
* Split AppDelegate into per-bridge files behind ConduitBridgeHost by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/794
* Move the chat library and Flutter-free app logic into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/795
* Move feature logic out of widgets into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/796
* Put CarPlay, SF Symbol images and Apple models behind host ports by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/797
* Move workspace, Hermes and composer rules into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/798
* Move notes audio, web embeds and tablet sidebar rules into conduit_core by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/799
* Fix edit-and-resend, workspace refresh and settings locale; pin startup rules by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/800
* Fix bounded web search tools being skipped by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/803
* Fix Hermes Desktop Gateway setup and Android speech language recovery by @cogwheel0 in https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/pull/804


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cogwheel0/conduit/compare/v4.1.8...v4.1.9
